summary: Validated iter248: Onboarding Checklist (backend + UI) and new 'new_location_login' notification event under 'security' category. Backend 6/6 pytest passed. Frontend: OnboardingChecklist card renders on /dashboard with all 6 steps (company, employees, payroll, bank, users, security), progress bar (83% for admin), CTA for incomplete step, line-through styling on done steps, dismiss button works and persists via /api/onboarding/dismiss. /notifications shows the new 'Sign-in from a new location' event under 'Security' category section.

issues: OnboardingTutorial modal (z-index 9999) initially intercepts clicks on the onboarding checklist dismiss button until the tutorial is completed/skipped. Not a regression — pre-existing tutorial overlay behavior. Working as designed once tutorial is dismissed.

action_items: Note: User's i18n preference defaulted to English (locale=en in localStorage) for the test admin. Spanish key 'onboardingChecklist.title' = 'Primeros pasos' is correctly defined in es.json; English renders as 'Getting started'. No raw keys visible. The requirement 'Spanish default' depends on the i18n init default — if testing strictly in Spanish, the user-level lang preference may need a server-side default; flagging in case strict Spanish-default rendering is required.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.py: _company_step counts 'rnc' as a key but iterates ('name','rnc','address','phone','industry') — total is 5 fields, but detail string says f'{filled}/5 campos' and 'done' requires filled>=4. Consistent and clear.
OnboardingChecklist.jsx: silent catch on API failure (setData(null)) — acceptable since the card simply hides; consider logging the error in dev for debuggability.
Dismiss endpoint is idempotent (always sets True). Good. Consider adding rate limiting on dismiss/restore to prevent spam (low priority).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing admin company data (6 employees, 8 payroll periods, 2 users → 5/6 steps done, security pending).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter248 features verified working end-to-end. Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iter248_onboarding_security.py is reusable. Run with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var set. Note: OnboardingTutorial modal (separate feature) may intercept clicks on the new OnboardingChecklist dismiss button on first dashboard load — skip the tutorial first in any UI test.
